name: Volcano Runners
summary:
Volcano Runners is an action-packed Gorilla Tag fangame that thrusts players into a thrilling volcanic landscape where agility and quick reflexes are key to survival. Set amidst the backdrop of an erupting volcano, this game offers an intense, immersive experience where every leap, swing, and climb could be the difference between victory and a fiery demise.
